mapper.sql: create_time, update_time, bool_delete_enum, version, id, name, sort, factory_id, workshop_id, production_line_id, user_id
mapper.select: SELECT gro.id 'groupId', gro.`name` 'groupName', line.id 'productionLineId', line.`name` 'productionLineName', ws.id 'workshopId', ws.`name` 'workshopName', fac.id 'factoryId', fac.`name` 'factoryName' FROM mes_building_groups gro LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line line ON gro.production_line_id = line.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_workshop ws ON gro.workshop_id = ws.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_factory fac ON fac.id = gro.factory_id WHERE gro.id = #{groupsId}

SELECT DISTINCT a.production_line_id 'productionLine.id', pl.`name` 'productionLine.name', b.id 'process.id', b.`name` 'process.name', b.type 'process.type' FROM mes_building_groups a LEFT JOIN mes_building_groups_team_link tl ON tl.groups_id = a.id AND tl.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_team t ON t.id = tl.team_id AND t.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_process b ON b.id = t.process_id AND b.bool_delete_enum=0 LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line pl ON pl.id=a.production_line_id AND pl.bool_delete_enum=0 WHERE a.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND a.workshop_id = #{workShopId} AND b.type =8

SELECT production_line.id production_line_id, production_line.`name` production_line_name, gro.id group_id, gro.`name` group_name FROM mes_building_groups gro LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line production_line ON gro.production_line_id = production_line.id LEFT JOIN mes_building_production_line_link production_line_link ON production_line_link.production_line_id = production_line.id AND production_line_link.bool_delete_enum = 0 WHERE gro.bool_delete_enum = 0 AND production_line.product_type & #{productType} AND production_line_link.link_id = #{structureClassId} AND production_line.bool_enabled_enum = 1 ORDER BY production_line.sort, gro.sort
